headline: A law that names a memorial trail route linking three September 11 memorial sites and gives the National Park Service responsibility for administering it.
what_it_does: The law designates a trail route called the September 11th National Memorial Trail Route. The route links the National 9/11 Memorial and Museum in New York, the National 9/11 Pentagon Memorial in Arlington, Virginia, and the Flight 93 National Memorial in Somerset County, Pennsylvania. The National Park Service will administer the route, but it will not count as a unit of the National Park System or as part of the National Trail System.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on October 13, 2021. The summary does not give a separate start date for the trail designation.
